about.heroDesc: Your trusted wholesale distribution partner for alcoholic beverages across Istanbul's European side.
about.expTitle: An Experienced and Trusted Name in the Industry
about.expP1: LEMARS Food & Beverage is a TAPDK-licensed company providing wholesale distribution services for alcoholic beverages across Istanbul's European side, backed by over 20 years of industry experience.
about.expP2: The market insight and consumer behavior expertise we've built over the years give our partners a strategic advantage. Our accumulated know-how in supply chain management and logistics planning is our most valuable asset in the industry.
about.expP3: With our qualified workforce and modern management approach, we provide uninterrupted service to over 1,800 points of sale, including restaurants, bars, hotels, grocery stores, and liquor shops.
about.comp1Desc: Over 20 years of accumulated knowledge enables us to accurately assess market dynamics and deliver added value to our partners.
about.comp2Desc: We closely track evolving market conditions and consumer preferences, supporting our partners in making sound product and inventory decisions.
about.comp3Desc: We efficiently manage the entire process from supplier to point of sale, reducing the operational burden on businesses.
about.comp4Desc: We connect your products with consumers through our broad portfolio and distribution network reaching 1,800+ points of sale. We provide point-of-sale visibility, promotional support, and market penetration.
about.comp5Desc: With our team of industry experts and contemporary management practices, we deliver fast decision-making and solution-oriented service.
about.adv1Desc: With over 400 products from domestic and imported brands, we serve as a one-stop solution for every business need.
about.adv2Desc: Our flexible and robust distribution infrastructure covers all of Istanbul's European side with same-day delivery.
about.adv3Desc: Our modern management approach creates customized supply plans and proactively resolves issues for every client.
about.adv4Desc: We leverage decades of expertise in market intelligence, consumer trends, and supply chain management.
about.adv5Desc: Our customer-focused team of specialists provides professional support at every stage of the process.
about.adv6Desc: All our operations are conducted in full compliance with applicable regulations, fully licensed and auditable.
about.ctaDesc: Let's build your distribution and supply strategy together.

section5.content: This website may use cookies to improve user experience. Essential cookies are required for the website to function properly. No analytics or marketing cookies are used.

section6.title: 6. Your Rights
section6.content: Under Article 11 of the KVKK (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law), you have the following rights:
list: To learn whether your personal data is being processed
To request information about the processing if your data has been processed
To learn the purpose of data processing and whether your data is being used in accordance with its purpose
To know the third parties to whom your data has been transferred, domestically or abroad
To request correction if your data has been processed inaccurately or incompletely
To request deletion or destruction of your data under the conditions specified in Article 7 of the KVKK

section7.title: 7. Contact
section7.content: To exercise your rights under the KVKK, you may contact us at info@lemarsgida.com.
